# Fixture provenance

- `test-image.jpg` is an original geometric JPEG generated by `npm run fixtures:image`. It is covered by this project's MIT license and contains no creator artwork. Browser tests intentionally serve JPEG bytes for advertised PNG names to verify content-based image extensions.
- `*.sanitized.json`, `*.sanitized.html` and `recon.json` contain limited public IDs, timestamps, media URL shapes and historical API observations. Referenced artwork is not included. Historical byte sizes/hashes describe those observations, not the synthetic JPEG.
- Archive decoder fixtures and their upstream notices are documented in [archives/README.md](archives/README.md).

Live recon captures go under ignored `artifacts/recon/`; they do not overwrite committed fixtures.
